Class TabView

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
net.tessel.fx.components.TabView
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class TabView extends javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
Closable, reorderable document tabs. 
TabView tabs = new TabView();
tabs.addTab("Readme.md", new Icon(Symbol.DOCUMENT, 16), new TextArea());
tabs.setAddTabHandler(() -> tabs.addTab("Untitled", new TextArea()));   // shows the + button
tabs.addTabViewListener(new TabView.TabViewListener() {
    public boolean tabClosing(TabView view, TabView.Tab tab) { return confirmClose(tab); }   // false vetoes
});
Drag tabs to reorder (setReorderable(boolean)), middle-click or Ctrl+W to close, Ctrl+PageUp / Ctrl+PageDown to switch. Tabs shrink to fit and then scroll with arrow buttons or the mouse wheel.
